title: Mid-Level Game Developer
description: Mid-level game developer position focused on independently building complex gameplay systems, optimizing performance, working with graphics and AI, and contributing to multiplayer features. Expected to work independently, mentor juniors, and make technical decisions within their systems.

skills.rationale: Advanced patterns, memory management, multithreading, and serialization are daily requirements
Full pipeline mastery including rendering, asset pipeline, UI systems, and audio integration
Quaternions, collision detection, pathfinding, and interpolation are expected competencies
Independently profiling and optimizing CPU, memory, and assets is a core mid-level expectation
Custom shader authoring, post-processing, and compute shader usage expected
Behavior trees, perception systems, utility AI, and group behaviors are mid-level territory
Game feel, balancing, playtesting methodology, and narrative integration
Git LFS, CI/CD for game builds, Perforce, and code review practices
Client-server architecture, RPCs, state sync, and basic matchmaking

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is the sum of weighted scores divided by sum of weights.
